value.name: Zariski Main Theorem: finite normalization

research.author: packet 2026-09-14: LLM-derived, no claim-specific human check, no Lean kernel build
research.reason: literature input; not admitted as an assumption until a session approves it

semantics: proved, not assumed: Mathlib carries Zariski's Main Theorem, so the factorisation through the normalisation is a theorem here; only the finiteness (rather than integrality) of the normalisation is still outside Mathlib
value.statement: A quasi-finite separated morphism factors as an open immersion into a finite morphism (the normalization of the target in the function field).
